$comment: Accord in the task's thread: Jodee summons it, the flow steps through at the top while points arrive from the three laptops, the words used in different senses are flagged and restated, and the shared summary is saved, with what's still open.
do: wait-text:Offline mode is our most requested feature

eval:(() => { const s = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Resize the open tabs"]'); if (!s) return; const r = s.getBoundingClientRect(); s.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, clientX: r.x, clientY: r.y + 10 })); const box = s.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect(); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: box.left + box.width * 0.26 })); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', {})); })()

eval:(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-conversation"]'); if (!c) return; let n = c; while (n && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(n).overflowY)) n = n.parentElement; if (!n) return; const go = () => n.scrollTo({ top: n.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); go(); new MutationObserver(go).observe(c, { childList: true, subtree: true }); })()
eval:(() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2')].find((e) => /^words$/i.test(e.textContent.trim())); h?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: 'smooth' }); })()
eval:(() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2')].find((e) => /^open items$/i.test(e.textContent.trim())); h?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: 'smooth' }); })()
